title: Hazel and the Cover
author: Tamsin Crane
blurb: Gideon Iversen, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
